The Great Indian Kapil Show के नए trailer में दिखा पंकज त्रिपाठी, विकास दिव्यकीर्ति और जाकिर खान का अनोखा अंदाज! 🤩

इस बार Kapil Sharma अपने कॉमेडी शो में अभिनेता पंकज त्रिपाठी, डॉक्टर विकास दिव्यकीर्ति और कॉमेडियन जाकिर खान की तिकड़ी की मेजबानी कर रहे हैं।
ट्रेलर में पंकज त्रिपाठी ने खुलासा किया कि वे विकास सर से पहली बार क्लासरूम में मिले थे और UPSC परीक्षा की तैयारी करना चाहते थे।
वहीं जाकिर खान ने विकास सर के साथ अपनी बॉन्डिंग पर एक मजेदार मजाक करके दर्शकों को हंसा-हंसाकर लोटपोट कर दिया। 😂
शो में सुनील ग्रोवर पूर्व प्रधानमंत्री अटल बिहारी वाजपेयी के पैरोडी रूप 'सरल बिहारी वाजपेयी' के अवतार में दर्शकों को चौंकाते दिखेंगे। 🎭
ट्रेलर आने के बाद फैंस इस सरप्राइज कॉम्बिनेशन और एपिसोड को देखने के लिए बेहद उत्सुक नजर आ रहे हैं। ✨

क्या आप पंकज त्रिपाठी, विकास सर और जाकिर की इस तिगड़ी को एक साथ देखने के लिए तैयार हैं? कमेंट्स में जरूर बताएं! 👇

ctx.title: Pankaj Tripathi says he wanted to prepare for UPSC as joins Vikas Divyakirti and Zakir Khan on The Great Indian Kapil Show
ctx.summary: The upcoming episode of The Great Indian Kapil Show brings actor Pankaj Tripathi, educator Vikas Divyakirti and comedian Zakir Khan together.
ctx.text:
After welcoming Shahid Kapoor , Mira Rajput and Ishaan Khatter on The Great Indian Kapil Show , Kapil Sharma is set to host another interesting trio on the comedy show. The latest trailer features actor Pankaj Tripathi, educator Dr Vikas Divyakirti and comedian Zakir Khan, who are seen sharing their connections and exchanging jokes with Kapil.
The trailer opens with Kapil welcoming the three guests. Pankaj reveals that he first met Vikas in a classroom. When Kapil asks him if he was preparing for the UPSC examination, Pankaj admits that he had wanted to prepare for the competitive exam. Kapil then jokes, “We all wanted to prepare for UPSC.”
Zakir also shares his connection with Vikas and leaves everyone laughing with a cheeky remark. “This might sound inappropriate, but I have slept a lot of Vikas sir,” he said, making the audience burst into laughter.
The trailer also features Sunil Grover in a parody appearance as late Prime Minister Atal Bihari Vajpayee, named Saral Bihari Vajpayee. His look and mannerisms of former Prime Minister left the audience surprised.
Fans were quick to express their excitement about the upcoming episode. One comment read, “So excited for the episode.” Another wrote, “Unexpected Collab 😍.” A third comment read, “This is going to be super fun,” while another fan said, “Eagerly waiting to watch” 🙌.
The previous episode featured Shahid, Mira and Ishaan. The Kapoor family had a fun time on the show, with Mira sharing how Shahid is always aware of everything happening around him. She explained that she waits for the conversation about serious cinema to end between Shahid and Ishaan before joining in. Shahid then teased her about the kind of conversations she enjoys, asking, “What kind of conversations do you like? ‘What’s happening in the film industry? What’s the latest gossip?’”
When Archana Puran Singh asked who among them enjoyed gossiping more, Shahid asked her to make a wild guess. Mira jumped in, saying, “He knows everything but he never says anything.” She added, “I don’t indulge in gossip.”
The Great Indian Kapil Show is a comedy talk show hosted by Kapil Sharma. The show features celebrity guests from the worlds of films, entertainment, sports and other fields, who join Kapil and his team for conversations, comedy sketches and fun interactions.
Vibha Maru is an Assistant Editor with Hindustan Times Entertainment, based in Delhi. With a decade of experience across digital and print media, she covers Bollywood, Hollywood and web shows.

A self-confessed cinephile who breathes Hindi cinema, Vibha can often be found sacrificing sleep after binge-watching films and web series. Though she holds a Commerce degree, she discovered her true calling in journalism after enrolling at the Indian Institute of Mass Communication (IIMC). She began her career covering Delhi's cultural scene, food, nightlife, concerts, and city life at The Times of India, before moving into full-time entertainment journalism with India Today.

At India Today, Vibha interviewed some of the biggest names in Bollywood and television while carving a niche for herself through film reviews, opinion pieces, nostalgic features, celebrity interviews, and trend-driven stories. She later brought her storytelling and editorial expertise to The Indian Express, where she continued to deepen her understanding of cinema through long-form entertainment explainers, retrospectives and feature writing.
